name: sds-playwright-bdd-mcp-framework
description: Enterprise Playwright testing framework with BDD support and MCP self-healing selectors

scripts.test:direct: concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "cross-env REUSE_SESSION=true playwright test --project ui-* --headed" -k --success first
scripts.test:ui:headless: concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "cross-env HEADLESS=1 playwright test --project ui-*" -k
scripts.test:chrome: concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "cross-env BROWSER=chrome playwright test" -k
scripts.test:firefox: concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "cross-env BROWSER=firefox playwright test" -k
scripts.test:edge: concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "cross-env BROWSER=edge playwright test" -k
scripts.test:webkit: concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "cross-env BROWSER=webkit playwright test" -k
scripts.test:chromium: concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "cross-env BROWSER=chromium playwright test" -k
scripts.test:bdd: npm run bdd:generate && concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --headed" -k
scripts.test:bdd:headless: npm run bdd:generate && concurrently "npm run start:mcp" "playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts" -k
scripts.test:all: npm run test:ui && npm run test:bdd
scripts.test:cross-browser: npm run test:chromium && npm run test:firefox && npm run test:webkit
